video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how a SQL JOIN combines a customers table and an orders table by matching IDs, and what a LEFT JOIN keeps

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

question_marks_enter.what: A violet question mark fades in beside each customer number in the orders table

id_outline_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the ID column of each table

id_headers_light.what: The headers of the two ID columns turn from pale to violet

id_outline_exit.what: The outlines around the ID columns fade away

match_link_draw.what: A glowing violet line draws itself across the gap from an order's customer number to the customer with the same ID

id_numbers_light.what: The two matching ID numbers turn from navy to violet

pair_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around a name in the customers table and around an amount in the orders table

pair_travel.what: The name and the amount of a matching pair travel down behind the query card and land side by side as one row of the result table

pair_chip_exit.what: The chips around the travelling name and amount fade away as they land

twice_bands_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind each of the two result rows that belong to the same customer

twice_bracket_draw.what: A violet bracket draws itself beside the result table, joining those two rows

twice_exit.what: The lavender bands and the bracket fade away

match_links_exit.what: The violet lines between the two tables fade away

lonely_row_dim.what: The row of the customer with no order fades from navy to pale gray

no_match_stub_draw.what: A short navy line draws itself from that customer's ID into the gap and stops without reaching an order

no_match_stub_exit.what: The short navy line fades away

join_word_out.what: The line 'JOIN orders' in the query slides up and fades out

left_join_in.what: The line 'LEFT JOIN orders' slides up into its place

left_underline_draw.what: A violet underline draws itself under the word LEFT

lonely_row_restore.what: The pale row of the customer with no order returns to navy

result_grow.what: The result table grows one row taller

kept_name_travel.what: The name of the customer with no order travels down behind the query card into the new last row of the result table

empty_box_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the empty amount cell of the new row

null_pill_wipe.what: A lavender pill with the word NULL spreads from left to right inside the empty cell
